concerns.text: FR-007 (causal language filter) is not addressed by any task; no task implements the required framing of correlations as associational only.
FR-013 (train primary regression model only on normalized records) lacks a dedicated task; the pipeline never enforces separation of normalized vs. raw subsets for training.
FR-017 (statistical validity check on the raw subset) is missing; there is no task that runs Shapiro‑Wilk and Levene’s tests and conditionally excludes the raw subset.
FR-018 (unit conversions for Archard normalization) is not covered by any task; no task explicitly handles conversion of linear or mass wear_rate to volume using density and geometry.
SC-001 (measure R² improvement over baseline Linear Regression) has no associated task; the pipeline never records a baseline R² for comparison.
SC-007 (data schema mismatch error reporting) is absent; no task validates required LST columns and aborts on mismatch.
No task creates or validates the `dataset.schema.yaml` contract; the contract is listed but no task references or generates it.
No task creates or validates the `feature_importance.schema.yaml` contract.
No task creates or validates the `model_output.schema.yaml` contract.
No task creates or validates the `model_report.schema.yaml` contract.
No task creates or validates the `output.schema.yaml` contract.
Phase 1 tasks exist, but there is no task that verifies the quickstart command actually runs the full pipeline end‑to‑end (beyond the minimal sample run).
Task T040 mentions runtime instrumentation, but no implementation (`code/pipeline.py::instrument_runtime`) or test (`tests/unit/test_runtime.py`) is present, leaving the 6‑hour limit unenforced.
